meta.name: archify
meta.description: Create polished, validated architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle/state diagrams as explorable standalone HTML with inline SVG, dark/light themes, optional trace motion, and PNG/JPEG/WebP/SVG/WebM export. Accept plain-language requirements or pasted Mermaid flowchart, sequenceDiagram, and stateDiagram input; inspect repository evidence when the diagram must reflect real code. Use when the user asks to visualize system architecture, infrastructure, cloud/security/network topology, technical workflows, API call sequences, request lifecycles, data pipelines, ETL/ELT, data lineage, state machines, or to convert/beautify Mermaid.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把系统结构与流程变成清晰直观的图表
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 需要把系统结构画出来给团队评审或留档。
copy.tagline_en: Turn system structures and flows into clear diagrams
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to visualize system structure for team review or documentation.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把你用大白话描述的系统结构、流程、调用顺序或状态变化，写成一份自包含、可探索的 HTML 架构图，支持明暗主题和 PNG、SVG 等格式导出。
howto.when: 当你要求可视化系统架构、基础设施或 API 调用顺序等，或要转换、美化粘贴的 Mermaid 图时触发。

say.text: 帮我画一张这套系统的架构图，我直接用大白话说
say.note: 会生成一份独立 HTML 架构图

say.text: 再导出一份 PNG 版本的图给我

howto.what_en: After install, Claude turns your plain-language description of a system, workflow, or call sequence into a self-contained, explorable HTML diagram with dark/light themes and PNG/SVG export.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to visualize system architecture, infrastructure, or API call sequences, or to convert or restyle a pasted Mermaid diagram.

say_en.text: Draw an architecture diagram of this system from my plain description
Convert this Mermaid sequenceDiagram into an Archify diagram
Also export a PNG version of the diagram
